name: Felix's Chest
summary: Felix's Chest lies in a Frostmane camp southwest of Anvilmar. It holds belongings lost by the exiled gnome during the flight from Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Refugee's Losses
sections.body: Felix Whindlebolt fled Gnomeregan with the other gnomes when troggs and toxic radioactive fallout drove them from the city. The refugees crossed into snowy Dun Morogh with whatever they could carry. In the confusion, Frostmane trolls scavenged the roads and overtook scattered survivors. Felix lost his toolkits and belongings, and the trolls hauled his sturdy chest to their camps in the crags southwest of Anvilmar.

faq.answer: Felix Whindlebolt's chest holds the personal belongings he salvaged while fleeing Gnomeregan. He left them behind in his rush to escape the lethal radiation; the contents mean little to the trolls, but they are remnants of his former life.

faq.q: Why do the Frostmane trolls have Felix's belongings?
aliases: why do trolls have felix chest
faq.answer: The Frostmane trolls have Felix's belongings because they ambushed scattered gnomish refugees and carried away their gear. The trolls harass travelers and scavenge through Coldridge Valley, and they took the refugees' discarded luggage back to their campsites.
Felix's Chest is southwest of Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, near the tents of a Frostmane troll settlement and other looted supplies.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Felix's Chest as a reminder of Gnomeregan's chaotic evacuation, when fleeing gnomes lost almost everything to the wilderness and scavengers.
